moments.text: Infrared view of flat, streaky ground with crosshair and black redaction boxes. A tiny pale pair of specks sits upper right of the crosshair: zoom in.
The pair of specks moves down past the crosshair's right arm and ends up below and right of it.
The pair stays just below-right of the crosshair, then rises to sit beside the crosshair centre.
The picture flashes white for about 0.2 s (6 frames), then the ground view returns as the clip ends.
